nodes.text: 🇬🇭 Health Alert: The Ghana Health Service has noted an increase in respiratory infections caused by Human Metapneumovirus (hMPV) in China and other parts of the Northern Hemisphere since late December 2024. This is not a new virus like COVID-19, but caution is advised. Stay safe! https://t.co/6Cq2lNbsiv
